output.one_liner: An open-source backend-as-a-service platform providing Postgres database, authentication, storage, and real-time subscription APIs.

auth.notes: Supports OAuth2 and personal access tokens (PAT) sent as Bearer tokens. PATs start with 'sbp_' prefix.

evidence.snippet: All API requests require an access token to be included in the Authorization header: Authorization Bearer <access_token>.
Personal access token (PAT): PATs are tokens with a custom expiry that you manually generate to access the Management API.
OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user, providing secure and limited access.
Supabase also supports API key authentication. Choose API Key as the authentication type, then paste a personal access token that starts with sbp_.

access.notes: Free tier available with self-serve signup. API keys accessible immediately from dashboard without approval. Local development sandbox via CLI.

evidence.snippet: Every request to your Supabase project carries an API key. Find your keys in Settings > API Keys section.
Create one at Account → Access Tokens. Supabase shows it only once, so copy it right away.
The Supabase CLI runs the entire Supabase stack on your own machine or in a CI environment, so you can build and test locally.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 120 requests per 1 minute per user, per project or organization, per endpoint on Management API

evidence.snippet: Supabase auto-generates an API directly from your database schema allowing you to connect through a restful interface.
It exposes everything you need from a CRUD API at the URL https://<project_ref>.supabase.co/rest/v1/.
Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.
Rate limits: 120 requests per 1 minute per user, per project or organization, per endpoint
Supabase provides a globally distributed Realtime service with Broadcast, Presence, and Postgres Changes features.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free tier with well-documented REST/GraphQL APIs, 235 available tools, and existing Composio toolkit.

overview_evidence.snippet: Supabase is an open-source backend-as-a-service providing a Postgres database, authentication, storage, and real-time subscription APIs for building modern applications.
Supabase auto-generates an API directly from your database schema allowing you to connect to your database through a restful interface.

unknown_reasons.mcp: Pages mention MCP capability in local development and AI tools sections but do not publish a URL to an official MCP server.
